trap_description: Model tempted to label REVISION or INCOMPATIBLE across 4-year gap

raw_evidence.content: In 2022, I really wanted to work at BigCorp. In 2026, I do not want to work at BigCorp.

semantic_blocks.content: In 2022, I really wanted to work at BigCorp. In 2026, I do not want to work at BigCorp.

source_span.text: In 2022, I really wanted to work at BigCorp
In 2026, I do not want to work at BigCorp

rationale: Different temporal validity bars INCOMPATIBLE. Gold is BEFORE with opposite polarity; REVISION is forbidden.

trap_description: Model tempted to emit COGNITIVE_SHIFT or REVISION

raw_evidence.content: In 2021, I loved microservices. In 2025, I prefer monorepos.

semantic_blocks.content: In 2021, I loved microservices. In 2025, I prefer monorepos.

rationale: Shift across time is represented by chronological order (BEFORE). COGNITIVE_SHIFT is strictly forbidden.

raw_evidence.content: In 2019, our team used Python. In 2023, our team used Rust.

semantic_blocks.content: In 2019, our team used Python. In 2023, our team used Rust.

rationale: Team tool usage shift over time linked via BEFORE.

raw_evidence.content: The staging server is running. The staging server is stopped.

semantic_blocks.content: The staging server is running. The staging server is stopped.

rationale: Contemporaneous contradictory states with overlapping time validly produce INCOMPATIBLE.

raw_evidence.content: The database cluster is operational. The database cluster is offline.

semantic_blocks.content: The database cluster is operational. The database cluster is offline.

rationale: Mutually exclusive status on identical cluster at identical time.
